'**Ice Fusion** / Target opponent reveals their hand. If Brain Freeze was **fused**, put an action card with cost 0 from their hand on top of their deck.' Blue printing: threshold cost = 0 exactly (yellow is <= 1, red <= 2 - see .drafts/brain_freeze_red.json, whose verified shape this copies).

FUSION ITSELF IS NOT AUTHORED: '<X> Fusion' fires engine-side from the card DB keywords field as an optional additional cost at PLAY time (ability_keywords.fusion, ability_keywords.py:582-607 - a REVEAL from hand). 'Was fused' gates on the marker fusion() writes: 'fused_<card.slug>' appended to the controller's current_turn_effects (ability_keywords.py:604-606), tested by FLAG_SET (condition_types.py:1032-1037 reads the flag against the source controller's current_turn_effects). Flag name is per-printing because fusion() keys it on card.slug. Timing holds: fusion resolves as a cost before the PLAY ability resolves, so by resolution the flag is set or permanently absent.

REVEAL: LOOK_AT zone HAND player OPPONENT amount ALL into their_hand (handler effect_types.py:3356-3415 reads zone/player/amount/into; HAND is a supported zone; ALL stores the whole hand as a list). KNOWN FIDELITY GAP: printed text says 'reveals', and LOOK_AT stores refs without setting the cards public - the information reaches the effect but the cards are not marked is_public. Accepted per the triage note ('Reveal hand = LOOK_AT(HAND, OPPONENT, ALL, into ref)'); no DSL effect both reveals a whole hand and stores it.

SELECTION DEVIATES FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberately: it named SELECT_FROM_REF, but that handler (effect_types.py:3540-3591) takes NO filter - its pool is the raw ref contents, so it would let me put ANY card from their hand on top, not just an Action with cost 0. Instead MOVE_MATCHING (effect_types.py:3593-3612) whose object-target spec filters the ref pool per candidate: filter conditions are compiled and evaluated with the CANDIDATE as the card argument (effect_types.py:731-733, 776-778), so CARD_IS_TYPE card_type Action (types union subtypes, condition_types.py:1309-1325 - matches release note 2, 'Action cards include any card with the type Action') and CARD_COST_LTE amount 0 (reads amount, condition_types.py:1219-1252) restrict the pool correctly. The controller then picks one via _ask_player with no STOP option - mandatory, matching release note 1 ('not optional. You must select a card if possible'); an empty filtered pool returns [] and the move is a silent no-op, which is the 'if possible' half. put_object routes through Zone.remove/add to the OWNER's deck top (destination_player_id=obj.owner in MOVE_MATCHING), i.e. THEIR deck, not mine. Release note 3 (no response between reveal and selection) holds structurally: both effects run inside one ability resolution and the engine offers no priority mid-resolution.

The fused gate wraps ONLY the put-back via CONDITIONAL_EFFECT when/then (effect_types.py:3697+ reads when/then/else; 'when' not 'conditions' - the loader pops the latter as an effect-level gate): the reveal happens whether or not the card was fused, exactly as printed.
